response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software development, including C++ and Dlang, and has worked on geospatial projects (GISCollective), but lacks direct experience with routing data pipelines, navigation systems, or modern C++ in a production environment at scale. His background in web/mobile and embedded systems is strong but not directly aligned with the core requirements of optimizing routing tiles and real-time traffic integration.
strengths: Experience with C++ and Dlang, showing familiarity with systems programming languages relevant to the role.
Geospatial project (GISCollective) demonstrates exposure to map data and collaborative platforms.
Proven track record in open-source contributions and technical leadership across diverse stacks.
concerns: No explicit experience with routing data pipelines, navigation systems, or geospatial data processing at scale.
Limited evidence of working with modern C++ (C++11/14/17/20) in a commercial or high-performance context.
Most recent roles focus on web/mobile development (TypeScript, Node.js) rather than systems or distributed computing.
